correctness.rationale: PASS: For r=2n+2 and K=span{e_0,...,e_{2r-1}}, compressed multiplication by z^r maps lower coordinates x_i to upper y_i. Orthogonal P keeps upper even indices r+2j, giving x_2j=y_2j and all other x_i=0. The kernel has dimension r and lies in zH². Quotient map Lh=(h_2j-h_(r+2j) for 2j indexed, h_i otherwise) is surjective with kernel M. Its composition L S*|M sends free y_2j to output 2j-1, y_2j+1 to -output 2j and y_0 to output r-1, making 2n+1 independent coordinates with only y_1 unused. Hence exact defect all n. Source verifier independently constructs integer matrices; independent rank checks for n=1..8 agree but do not replace symbolic rank count. Upper bound 2n+1 is known from Chattopadhyay–Khan, not an independent new theorem.
